name: Kuttu roti
full_name: Buckwheat flour roti (kuttu ki roti), fasting style
basis: About 70 g buckwheat flour and 2 g ghee per 100 g of cooked roti; flour values from IFCT 2017.

name: Kuttu puri
full_name: Buckwheat flour puri (kuttu ki puri), deep fried
basis: Kuttu roti dough deep fried, absorbing about 14 g oil per 100 g.

name: Singhara roti
full_name: Water chestnut flour roti (singhare ki roti), fasting style
basis: About 65 g singhara flour, mashed potato to bind, and 2 g ghee per 100 g of cooked roti.

name: Rajgira roti
full_name: Amaranth flour roti (rajgira ki roti), fasting style
basis: About 65 g amaranth flour, mashed potato to bind, and 3 g ghee per 100 g of cooked roti; flour values from IFCT 2017.

name: Samak rice (cooked)
full_name: Barnyard millet (samak, sama ke chawal, vrat ke chawal), boiled
basis: Raw barnyard millet values from IFCT 2017, cooked with about three times its weight of water.

name: Samak rice khichdi
full_name: Barnyard millet khichdi with potato and peanuts (vrat khichdi)
basis: Cooked samak rice with potato, a few roasted peanuts and ghee.

name: Roasted makhana
full_name: Fox nuts (makhana, lotus seeds) roasted in a little ghee
basis: Dried lotus seed values from USDA FoodData Central with about 5% ghee added.

name: Vrat aloo sabzi
full_name: Potatoes cooked in ghee with cumin and sendha namak (vrat wale aloo)
basis: Boiled potato values from IFCT 2017 with about 4 g ghee per 100 g.

name: Vrat lauki sabzi
full_name: Bottle gourd cooked in ghee with cumin and sendha namak, fasting style
basis: Bottle gourd values from IFCT 2017 with about 3 g ghee per 100 g.

name: Vrat kaddu sabzi
full_name: Pumpkin (kaddu) cooked in ghee with sendha namak, fasting style
basis: Pumpkin values from IFCT 2017 with about 3 g ghee and a little jaggery per 100 g.

name: Sweet potato chaat
full_name: Boiled sweet potato (shakarkandi) with lemon and sendha namak
basis: Boiled sweet potato values from USDA FoodData Central.

name: Fruit chaat
full_name: Mixed seasonal fruit with lemon and chaat masala
basis: An even mix of apple, banana, papaya and pomegranate, values from USDA FoodData Central.

name: Dates (khajur)
basis: Deglet Noor date values from USDA FoodData Central, entered by hand; one date is about 7 g.
